credit.credit-words: He Will Never Fail to Help
WORDS: Charles W. Naylor, pub.1918. MUSIC: Henry C. Clausen, pub.1918; arr. Public Domain.

The Lord... doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed. Dt. 31:8 They that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, Lord, hast not forsaken them that seek thee. Psa. 9:10
